build_stable_quantized_cdf: build a quantized CDF from a PDF tensor for arithmetic coding with configurable range bits
create_arithmetic_coder: create an ArithmeticCoder instance to encode symbols into a compressed bit stream on a file object
encode_symbols_with_push: encode a sequence of symbols by pushing each symbol with its quantized CDF to the coder
decode_symbols_with_pull: decode symbols from a compressed bit stream by pulling each symbol with its matching quantized CDF
test_arithmetic_coding_roundtrip: test the arithmetic coder and decoder by encoding then decoding random symbols and verifying correctness
